description: A REAL CLOUD BROWSER FOR A TASK ON A SITE: the user's signed-in account (a persona_id from writ_personas: the password stays sealed in Writ, and sessions never ask for a password), a click, form, submit or search inside an app, or a page a plain fetch cannot open (login wall, 403, CAPTCHA). Opens the browser and returns the first page; writ_browser_act drives it (Writ runs no model here). Recording is always on: writ_browser_save turns the session into a workflow that replays without a browser, writ_browser_cancel closes it (an open browser bills). The start answer carries the action vocabulary, the recording rules and, with a persona, the 2FA rules. NOT FOR: reading pages (writ_scrape). An API: writ_website_to_api opens this same browser, bound to a build.

execution_target.description: cloud | auto | local (the user's own desktop app).

use_residential.description: Residential exit (bot walls, another country). Omitted: Writ's residential list decides. Pair with residential_country.
